agent_explanation: Stationary light body 0 is struck by fast heavy body 1 (vx~27.7) around steps 25-28, emerging with vx~30.64 m/s (step 28). Covering ~0.52 units per dt=0.017 step toward the right boundary, it goes from x~18.92 at step 32 to x~19.45 at step 33, overshooting the allowed centre (20-r-tol) by 0.25. The right boundary collision fails to stop/reflect it in time, so it exits the arena — fast-body boundary handling inadequate after energetic body-body momentum transfer.
